newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: NIPPECRAFT MAKES S$8 MLN UNIT PROVISION.
newsitem.headline: NIPPECRAFT MAKES S$8 MLN UNIT PROVISION.

text.p: Nippecraft Ltd said on Wednesday it was adding Singapore $8.0 million to provisions for the year ended March 31, 1997 for investments made in units which were restructured and reorganised in the year.

Nippecraft said in a statement extra provision for the diminution in values of investments in the subsidiaries would not affect group results for the year to March 31, 1997, nor the balance sheet of the group at that date.
"The results of the respective subsidiaries have been fully reflected in the consolidated results and balance sheet of the group at March 31, 1997," the statement said.
Nippecraft is a unit of Asia Pulp & Paper Co Ltd, which bought a US$32 million, 64 percent stake in the firm in March.
